title: Just okay
text:
1) for $25, you get five flavors, two bags of each, for a total of ten bags, and a little tea bag holder plate. But on the Lah Tea Dah Amazon page, you get get a sampler set for $25 that includes 9 flavors, two bags each, for a total of 18 bags. That sounds like a much better deal to me - I don't need the little plate, especially if that's going to be included in every box.
2) each bag can be reused 1-2 times. I'm just not sure of the point of this - I'd rather just more single use bags, especially because I don't always drink multiple cups of tea throughout the day.
3) The flavors were very good, so that's a plus. But, 4 out of the 5 had caffeine. I wish there was at least one other option included that didn't have caffeine.
label: neutral
